local_replicates.note: local2 and local5 inputs never exceed 103 bytes (local2 57), below every cap, so the runs of one arm and seed at caps 128, 256 and full share inputs, data order and seed: they are replicates, not different caps. Their per-config entries are kept as run. Here each arm is pooled over all its runs (mean and sample SD over runs), and the bootstrap uses each token's correctness averaged over them.
